title: MLX Runner and Cache Management
summary: This module provides core functionalities for running MLX models, including efficient key-value cache management for attention mechanisms and snapshotting for conversation resumption and branching.

nodes.label: MLX Generator
nodes.title: MLX Generator
nodes.description: Generates MLX-specific code from C++ source files using Tree-sitter for parsing and Go templates for output.

nodes.label: Text Generation Pipeline
nodes.title: Text Generation Pipeline
nodes.description: Manages the end-to-end process of text generation, including prefill, decoding, and interaction with the KV cache and sampler.

nodes.label: KV Cache Management
nodes.title: KV Cache Management
nodes.description: Handles the storage, retrieval, and eviction of key-value states for attention mechanisms, supporting both recurrent and rotating caches.

nodes.label: Cache Snapshotting
nodes.title: Cache Snapshotting
nodes.description: Provides mechanisms for creating and restoring snapshots of the KV cache, enabling conversation branching and efficient resumption.

nodes.label: Sampling Logic
nodes.title: Sampling Logic
nodes.description: Implements various sampling strategies (e.g., top-k, top-p, min-p, penalties) to select the next token during text generation.

nodes.label: MLX Model Forward Pass
nodes.title: MLX Model Forward Pass
nodes.description: Represents the core MLX model's forward computation, which processes input tokens and updates the KV cache.

nodes.label: Tokenizer
nodes.title: Tokenizer
nodes.description: Converts text to token IDs and vice-versa, and identifies end-of-sequence tokens.

groups.label: Model Execution
groups.title: Model Execution
groups.description: Components responsible for running the MLX model and managing its computational flow.

groups.label: Cache System
groups.title: Cache System
groups.description: Manages the key-value cache for attention mechanisms, including storage, rotation, and snapshotting capabilities.

groups.label: Token Sampling
groups.title: Token Sampling
groups.description: Handles the probabilistic selection of the next token based on model logits and various sampling parameters.

groups.label: Utility Components
groups.title: Utility Components
groups.description: Supporting components for code generation and external interfaces.
